encodedUser.description: Encoded (raw) user of URL, ex. user = 'c3iot'.

encodedPassword.description: Encoded (raw) raw password of URL, ex. password = 'pwd'.

port.description: Port Number of URL, ex. port = 8080. Will null if missing.

encodedQuery.description: Encoded (raw) query of URL (after the `?` mark), ex. 'ion=1&espv=8'. (This will not include the fragment.)

encodedFragment.description: Encoded (raw) fragment of URL (after the `#` mark), ex. 'chapter1'.

encodedReference.description: The URL-encoded branch or tag name

originalScheme.description:
The scheme of the original url, if this GitUrl was generated by {@link fromString}.  {@link toCloneableUrl}
will return a url with this scheme.

title:
Helper type to represent Git file urls.
GitHub: git://token@github.com/owner/repoName/reference/encodedPath
GitHub: git://token@gitHubEnterpriseDomain/owner/repoName/reference/encodedPath
AzureDevOps: git://token@owner.visualstudio.com/projectName/_git/repoName/reference/encodedPath
AzureDevOps: git://dev.azure.com/owner/projectName/_git/repoName/reference/encodedPath

In addition to standard {@link Url} fields like host and port, this type contains git-specific
fields like organization, project, repository, and reference.  Not all git implementations
use all of these fields.
name: GitUrl
